definitions.explanation: Relating to translation or conversion from Japanese to English.

examples.japanese: {和英|わえい}⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: To look up a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: {和英|わえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look it up in a Japanese-English dictionary.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{和英|わえい}⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: To use an online Japanese-English dictionary.

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{和英|わえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}いやすい→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This Japanese-English dictionary has many example sentences and is easy to use.

notes:
{和英|わえい} combines 和 (Japanese) + 英 (English) to indicate the Japanese-to-English direction. Used primarily as a prefix.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和英|わえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧/⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧: Japanese-English dictionary
- {和英|わえい}⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧: Japanese-to-English translation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{英和|えいわ}→英和：04018_eiwa⟧: English-to-Japanese (reverse direction)
- {和英|わえい}⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: for looking up Japanese words to find English equivalents
- ⟦{英和|えいわ}→英和：04018_eiwa⟧⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧: for looking up English words to find Japanese equivalents

COMMON PATTERNS:
The 和〜 prefix means "Japanese" in many compound words:
- ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧: Japanese food
- ⟦{和風|わふう}→和風：12034_wafuu⟧: Japanese style
- ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧: Japanese-style room
